dedupe_keys.name: programme travaux communs des operateurs gaziers

description: Programme Travaux Communs des Opérateurs Gaziers is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce Programme Travaux commun permet aux expéditeurs de gaz de visualiser au même endroit les restrictions appliquées par les différents opérateurs sur les points d’entrée et de sortie amont de la TRF (Trading Region France). Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Infrastructures. Its keywords are PTC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
